encodings.note: This instruction is used to bind information to a platform by encrypting it with a platform-specific wrapping key.

exceptions.when: PBNDKB is not supported in protected mode.
PBNDKB is not supported in real-address mode.
PBNDKB is not supported in virtual-8086 mode.
Same exceptions as in protected mode.

If the values of RBX and RCX are not both canonical. If RBX or RCX is not 256B aligned. If RBX = RCX. If any of the reserved bytes in the input bind structure are set (including bytes in BTDATA). If the value of the key-generation control in the BTDATA field of the input bind structure is not 0 or 1. #PF(fault-code) If a page fault occurs in accessing memory operands.
If any of the LOCK/REP/Operand Size/VEX prefixes are used. If the current privilege level is not 0. If CPUID.07H.01H:EBX.PBNDKB[1] = 0.
